from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FilingArRecord(BaseModel):
    """An extracted accounts receivable record from a single company filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company filing this report")
    accounts_receivable_amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of accounts receivable as reported")
    accounts_receivable_unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit or scale of the amount (e.g., 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars')")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The date or period end associated with this balance sheet")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text containing the amount and label")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    filings: list[FilingArRecord]
